name: setup
description: Create an account and receive an automated phone call to verify your number.

options.name: phone_number
options.description: Phone number or PBX extension that should receive alert calls.

name: verify
description: Activate your account using the six-digit code from your verification call.

options.name: verification_code
options.description: Enter the six-digit code from your verification call.

name: update-account
description: Change an account's phone number and verify the new number.

options.name: account_number
options.description: Choose the verified account you want to change.

options.name: phone_number
options.description: New phone number or PBX extension to verify.

name: remove-account
description: Permanently delete one of your registered accounts and its links.

options.name: account_number
options.description: Choose the account you want to permanently delete.

name: resend-code
description: Send another verification call for your pending account.

name: accounts
description: Show all verified accounts registered to your Discord user.

name: cancel-setup
description: Cancel your pending account setup and delete its unverified account.

name: link-account
description: Forward alerts from one of your accounts to another account you own.

options.name: from
options.description: Your account that will generate the alerts.

options.name: to
options.description: Your account that should also receive those alerts.

name: unlink-account
description: Stop forwarding alerts between two of your linked accounts.

options.name: from
options.description: The source account in the existing link.

options.name: to
options.description: The destination account in the existing link.

name: account-links
description: Show the alert-forwarding links configured for your accounts.
